
# Draft  structure: for site polaris
  structure:
    site:
      slug: polaris
      name: Polaris
    spaces:

        name: Documentation
        type: product-docs
        collections:

            title: Guides
            pages:

                title: Start here
                source: docs/guides/start.md
          - slug: admin

              - slug: admin-overview

        pages:

            title: Polaris
            source: README.md

# Verbatim pass  fills the pages that have a source
  passes:
    - name: docs
      kind: verbatim
      target: polaris/docs
      triggers: [push]
      options:
        files:
          - include: README.md
            slug: overview
          - include: docs/**/*.md
            stripPrefix: docs
          - include: packages/admin/README.md
            collection: admin
            slug: admin-overview
